full_prompt_en: A square vividly colored drawing brings two horse heads close together, filling almost the entire frame with dense rainbow linework. The background is a tightly woven field of violet, magenta, teal, and dark blue strokes, with little open space around the animals. On the left, a pale horse faces slightly toward the viewer and lowers its muzzle toward the bottom center. Its forehead and nose are mostly cream and white, but countless short lines of yellow, pink, turquoise, and lavender run through the light coat. Both upright ears reach the top edge. A thick forelock crosses diagonally from the upper center over one side of the face, mixing pale peach and electric blue strands. The horse's dark eye sits in a patch of cool purple shadow, while its nostrils and lower muzzle carry small pink and teal highlights. On the right, a second horse presses its orange-gold head against the first. Its face turns toward the lower left, and one large dark eye looks downward beneath a deep aubergine brow. Saturated orange, red, and yellow strokes describe the cheek and forehead, while a broad black-violet mane occupies the upper and right edges. The two heads overlap at the center, with their muzzles nearly touching near the bottom. Their outlines are not drawn as single clean lines; the direction and density of colored marks carve out the forms. Cool blue-green flecks gather in the shadows between the animals, strengthening the contrast with the warm face at right. The lighting reads as bright and even across both heads, with lighter strokes clustered on raised planes and darker complementary colors in the recesses. Every surface appears handworked, almost fibrous, from many short repeated pencil-like marks. No horizon or readable text is visible. The overall composition is intimate and energetic, using opposing warm and cool colors and tightly interlaced strokes to make a quiet pair feel vibrantly alive.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形鲜艳彩绘把两匹马的头部拉得很近，密集的彩虹色线条几乎填满全幅。背景是一片紧密编织的紫、洋红、青绿与深蓝笔痕，动物周围几乎没有空白。左侧，一匹浅色马略朝观者，口鼻低向下方中央。额头和鼻梁主要是奶油色与白色，但无数黄色、粉色、绿松石色和浅紫短线穿过浅色毛皮。两只竖耳伸到上缘。厚厚的额鬃从上方中央斜跨脸的一侧，混合淡桃色和电蓝色发丝。深色眼睛坐在冷紫阴影中，鼻孔和下口鼻带细小粉色与青绿亮部。右侧，第二匹马把橙金色的头靠向第一匹。它的脸转向左下，一只大深色眼睛从深茄紫色眉影下向下望。饱和橙、红、黄笔痕描述面颊和额头，宽阔的黑紫色鬃毛占据上方和右缘。两颗头在中央交叠，口鼻在底部附近几乎相触。轮廓不是由单一干净线条勾出，而是靠彩色痕迹的方向和密度刻画。冷蓝绿细屑聚在两匹马之间的阴影处，强化与右侧暖色面孔的对比。光线在两颗头上显得明亮均匀，凸起平面聚集较浅笔痕，凹处则使用较深的互补色。每一处表面都由许多重复的短铅笔般线条加工，几乎有纤维感。没有地平线或可读文字。整体构图亲密而充满活力，以相对的冷暖颜色和紧密交织的笔痕，让安静的一对显得生气勃勃。
style_prompt_en: The colored drawing is constructed from dense short pencil-like strokes in saturated complementary hues. Instead of smooth blending, thousands of directional marks accumulate into volume, so even pale areas shimmer with yellow, pink, cyan, and lavender. Warm orange and red occupy one broad side of the composition, opposed by turquoise, violet, and dark blue fields. The strokes turn with each curved surface, making their direction as important as their color. Boundaries remain soft and fibrous where neighboring marks interlace, while concentrated dark accents sharpen a few focal points. Light is evenly distributed but appears strongest wherever small bright strokes gather densely; shadows gain depth from cool chromatic layers rather than neutral black alone. Close cropping and overlapping rounded forms create intimacy within a restless patterned field. The overall effect is tactile and intensely alive, with visible manual repetition transforming a familiar shape into a vibrating color structure.
style_prompt_zh: 这种彩色绘画由高饱和互补色的密集短铅笔般笔痕构成。成千上万的定向线条代替平滑融合，累积成体积，因此浅色区域也因黄、粉、青和浅紫而闪动。暖橙与红色占据构图宽阔一侧，绿松石色、紫色和深蓝色域与之相对。笔痕沿弯曲表面转向，方向和颜色同样重要。相邻线条互相交织之处，边界柔软而有纤维感；聚集的深色重音则让少数焦点更锐利。光线分布均匀，但大量细小亮笔痕聚集处显得最亮；阴影由冷色彩层叠加深，而不只依靠中性黑。紧密裁切和相互遮挡的圆润形体在躁动的花纹色域里创造亲密感。整体效果可触且生命力强，可见的手工重复把熟悉形状转化为振动的色彩结构。
theme_en: Two close horse heads in densely colored rainbow linework
theme_zh: 两匹马的近景头部，以密集彩虹色线条绘成
name: Jane Small
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
